```{r load-data}
incidents <- read_rds(here("posts", "crime", "data", "clean", "criminal_incidents.rds"))

incident_summary <-  read_rds(here("posts", "crime", "data", "clean", "criminal_incident_summary.rds"))

csi <- read_rds(here("posts", "crime", "data", "clean", "crime_severity_index.rds"))

homicide_victims <- read_rds(here("posts", "crime", "data", "clean", "homicide_victims.rds"))
```

```{r create-ggplot-themes, include=FALSE}
# set custom colours and colour groups (ggcolours snippet)
ontgreen <- "darkgreen"
habsred <- "#AF1E2D"
habsred50 <- prismatic::clr_mix(habsred, "white", ratio = 0.5)
cowboysilver <- "#869397"
cowboysilver50 <- prismatic::clr_mix(cowboysilver, "white", ratio = 0.5)
cowboysilver_alpha30 <- adjustcolor(cowboysilver, alpha.f = 0.3)
dodgerblue <- "dodgerblue4"
dodgerblue50 <- prismatic::clr_mix(dodgerblue, "white", ratio = 0.5)
manual_5_colours <- c(habsred, habsred50, cowboysilver, dodgerblue50, dodgerblue)
manual_4_colours <- c(habsred, habsred50, dodgerblue50, dodgerblue)
manual_3_colours <- c(habsred, cowboysilver, dodgerblue)
manual_2_colours <- c(cowboysilver, dodgerblue)

# Create the Tufte-inspired theme (ggtufte snippet)
theme_tufte <- function(base_size = 13, base_family = "") {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      # Text elements
      plot.title = element_markdown(
        size = base_size * 1.0,
        hjust = 0,
        vjust = 1,
        margin = margin(0, 0, 5, 0),
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_markdown(
        size = base_size * 0.7,
        hjust = 0,
        vjust = 1,
        margin = margin(0, 0, 10, 0),
        color = "black",
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.caption = element_markdown(
        size = base_size * 0.6,
        hjust = 0,
        vjust = 1,
        margin = margin(t = 10),
        color = cowboysilver
      ),

      # Axis elements - minimal but functional
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = base_size * 0.8,
        margin = margin(t = base_size * 0.25)
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_markdown(
        size = base_size * 0.8,
        margin = margin(r = base_size * 0.25),
        hjust = 0
      ),

      # Minimal axis lines - only where data meets axis
      axis.line.x = element_line(
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.5,
        linetype = "solid"
      ),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),

      # Axis ticks
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.length.x = unit(0.15, "cm"),
      axis.minor.ticks.length = rel(0.5),

      # Gridlines
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
        color = "grey80",
        linewidth = 0.3
      ),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),

      # Legend - clean and minimal
      legend.position = "inside",
      legend.position.inside = c(-0.0, 1.02),
      legend.justification = "left",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      #legend.margin = margin(t = 20, b = 20),
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(
        size = base_size * 0.8,
        margin = margin(r = 10)
      ),
      #legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.spacing = unit(0.1, "cm"),
      legend.box.spacing = unit(0.1, "cm"),

      # Faceting - minimal
      strip.text = element_text(
      hjust = 0,
      size = base_size * 0.8,
      margin = margin(b = base_size * 0.5),
      face = "bold"
      ),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing.y = unit(1.5, "lines"),

      # Plot settings - left justify all
      plot.margin = margin(
        t = base_size,
        r = base_size,
        b = base_size,
        l = base_size
      ),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.caption.position = "plot",

      # Remove panel border
      panel.border = element_blank(),

      # Background
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
}

# Set as the default theme for all plots
theme_set(theme_tufte(base_size = 13, base_family = ""))

# create base size object
base_size <- 13

# consistent colours for the regions compared throughout
comp_colours <- c(
  "WRPS" = dodgerblue,
  "Canada" = habsred,
  "Ontario" = ontgreen,
  "Other Big 12" = cowboysilver50
)

# colours for the WRPS vs nearby cities comparisons
local_colours <- c(
  "WRPS" = dodgerblue,
  "Guelph" = dodgerblue50,
  "London" = cowboysilver,
  "Hamilton" = habsred
)
```

```{r create-big-12-tibble}
big_12 <- personnel |>
  filter(region %in% c("Canada", "Ontario") | in_big_12) |>
  mutate(comparison_group = if_else(region %in% c("Canada", "Ontario", "WRPS"), region, "Other Big 12"))

big_12_join <- big_12 |>
  select(geo_uid, in_big_12, comparison_group) |>
  distinct()

csi <- csi |>
  left_join(big_12_join, join_by(geo_uid))

incident_summary <- incident_summary |>
  left_join(big_12_join, join_by(geo_uid))

incident_totals <- incident_totals |>
  left_join(big_12_join, join_by(geo_uid))

incidents <- incidents |>
  left_join(big_12_join, join_by(geo_uid))

big_12_financials <- big_12_financials |>
  left_join(big_12_join |> select(-in_big_12), join_by(geo_uid))

# cities used for the local comparisons
local_cities <- names(local_colours)
```

```{r set-reference-years}
# First and latest year in each table - every year reference in the titles, subtitles
# and axes below flows from these, so the file updates itself as new data arrives
first_year_incidents <- min(incidents$year)
latest_year_incidents <- max(incidents$year)

first_year_incident_summary <- min(incident_summary$year)
latest_year_incident_summary <- max(incident_summary$year)

first_year_csi <- min(csi$year)
latest_year_csi <- max(csi$year)

first_year_personnel <- min(personnel$year)
latest_year_personnel <- max(personnel$year)

first_year_financials <- min(big_12_financials$year)
latest_year_financials <- max(big_12_financials$year)

first_year_homicides <- min(homicide_victims$year)
latest_year_homicides <- max(homicide_victims$year)

# baselines for the rolling ten-year comparisons
decade_ago_incidents <- latest_year_incidents - 10
decade_ago_personnel <- latest_year_personnel - 10

# the personnel survey skips years - name the gaps in the captions rather than hard-coding them
personnel_missing_years <- setdiff(first_year_personnel:latest_year_personnel, personnel$year) |>
  as.character() |>
  str_flatten_comma(last = " and ")

# financial reporting lags for some services, so use the most recent year in which
# all but at most one of the Big 12 reported, and name the non-reporters in the subtitle
latest_year_financials_reported <- big_12_financials |>
  filter(!is.na(total_exp_per_capita)) |>
  count(year) |>
  filter(n >= max(n) - 1) |>
  slice_max(year, n = 1) |>
  pull(year)

financials_not_reporting <- setdiff(
  unique(big_12_financials$region),
  big_12_financials |>
    filter(year == latest_year_financials_reported, !is.na(total_exp_per_capita)) |>
    pull(region)
) |>
  str_flatten_comma(last = " and ")
```

Every chart below uses the same data as `test.qmd`; only the styling has been rebuilt from the snippets in `r.snippets`. The snippet used is named in a comment at the top of each chunk.

## Criminal Incidents

### Waterloo Region, Ontario, and Canada

```{r plot-incidents-vs-Can-Ont}
# ggline
plot_data <- incident_summary |>
  filter(str_detect(region, "WRPS|Canada|Ontario"))

# Set x min and max
x_min <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> min()
x_max <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> max()

# Define scale colours
group_colours <- comp_colours

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = year, y = incidents_per_100k_all, colour = region)) +

  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = "", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    breaks = seq(x_min, x_max, 5),
    minor_breaks = seq(x_min, x_max, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08)),
    position = "bottom"
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    position = "right",
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ",", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))   # lines should not sit on the axis
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = group_colours
  ) +

  guides(x = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +

  # Right-axis label positioning: sit labels above gridlines
  theme(
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(
      size = rel(1),
      hjust = 1.0,
      vjust = -0.5,
      margin = margin(r = 15, l = -25)
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = str_glue("Number of Criminal Incidents: {first_year_incident_summary}-{latest_year_incident_summary}"),
    subtitle = "Per 100,000 population<br>",
    caption = "Source: Statistics Canada | *Charting Waterloo Region*"
  )
```

[Police-Reported Crime Statistics in Canada, `r latest_year_incident_summary` - Stats Can Analysis](https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/daily-quotidien/250722/dq250722a-eng.htm)

## Homicide Victims

### Canada

```{r plot_hom-victims-cma}
# ggline + ggannotate
# first year the CMA / non-CMA split is reported
first_year_cma <- homicide_victims |>
  filter(city == "Total CMA", !is.na(incidents_per_100k)) |>
  pull(year) |>
  min()

plot_data <- homicide_victims |>
  filter(province == "Canada")

# Set x min and max
x_min <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> min()
x_max <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> max()

# Define scale colours
group_colours <- set_names(
  manual_3_colours,
  c("Total All Regions", "Total Non-CMA", "Total CMA")
)

# Federal governing party, with the year each period began
party_data <- tibble(
  start = c(1961, 1963, 1968, 1979, 1980, 1984, 1993, 2006, 2015),
  label = c("C", "L", "L", "C", "L", "C", "L", "C", "L")
) |>
  mutate(mid = (start + lead(start, default = x_max)) / 2)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = year, y = incidents_per_100k, colour = city)) +

  # Party change markers
  geom_vline(
    data = party_data |> filter(start > x_min),
    aes(xintercept = start),
    linetype = "dashed",
    alpha = 0.7,
    colour = cowboysilver,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +

  # Party in power labels
  geom_text(
    data = party_data,
    aes(x = mid, y = Inf, label = label),
    vjust = 1.4,
    size = 3.2,
    colour = "grey30",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = "", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    breaks = seq(x_min, x_max, 10),
    minor_breaks = seq(x_min, x_max, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05)),
    position = "bottom"
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    position = "right",
    limits = c(1.2, 3.2),
    breaks = seq(1.2, 2.8, 0.4),
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ",", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.07))
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = group_colours
  ) +

  guides(x = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +

  theme(
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(
      size = rel(1),
      hjust = 1.0,
      vjust = -0.5,
      margin = margin(r = 12, l = -15)
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = str_glue("Number of Homicide Victims in Canada, per 100,000 people: {first_year_homicides}-{latest_year_homicides}"),
    subtitle = str_glue("Including breakdown between Census Metropolitan Areas and Non-CMAs for {first_year_cma}-{latest_year_homicides}<br>"),
    caption = "Source: Statistics Canada | *Charting Waterloo Region*"
  )
```

### Waterloo Region, Ontario, and Canada

```{r homicide-wrps}
# ggline
plot_data <- homicide_victims |>
  filter(
    city %in% c("Total CMA", "KWC"),
    province %in% c("Canada", "Ontario"),
    year >= 1981    # no data at CMA level before 1981
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    city = case_when(
      city == "KWC" ~ "KWC CMA",
      province == "Ontario" ~ "All Ontario CMAs",
      province == "Canada" ~ "All Canadian CMAs"
    )
  )

line_colours <- c(
  "KWC CMA" = dodgerblue,
  "All Canadian CMAs" = habsred,
  "All Ontario CMAs" = ontgreen
)

# Set x min and max
x_min <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> min()
x_max <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> max()

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = year, y = incidents_per_100k, colour = city)) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = "", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    breaks = seq(x_min, x_max, 5),
    minor_breaks = seq(x_min, x_max, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05)),
    position = "bottom"
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    position = "right",
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ",", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))   # lines should not sit on the axis
  ) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = line_colours
  ) +
  
  guides(x = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +
  
  theme(
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(
      size = rel(1),
      hjust = 1.0,
      vjust = -0.5,
      margin = margin(r = 12, l = -20)
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Homicide victims",
    subtitle = "Incidents per 100,000 residents<br>",
    caption = "Source: Statistics Canada | *Charting Waterloo Region*"
  )
```

```{r homicide-wrps-3yr-mov-avg}
# ggline
plot_data <- homicide_victims |>
  filter(
    city %in% c("Total CMA", "KWC"),
    province %in% c("Canada", "Ontario"),
    year >= 1981    # no data at CMA level before 1981
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    city = case_when(
      city == "KWC" ~ "KWC CMA",
      province == "Ontario" ~ "All Ontario CMAs",
      province == "Canada" ~ "All Canadian CMAs"
    )
  ) |> 
  group_by(city) |> 
  arrange(year) |>      # essential: slider works on position, not on the year value
  mutate(
    ma_3_incidents_per_100k = slide_dbl(
      incidents_per_100k,            # column to average
      .f = mean,        # function applied to each window
      .before = 2,      # 2 prior rows + current row = 3-year window
      .complete = TRUE  # NA until a full window exists
    )
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(!is.na(ma_3_incidents_per_100k))

line_colours <- c(
  "KWC CMA" = dodgerblue,
  "All Canadian CMAs" = habsred,
  "All Ontario CMAs" = ontgreen
)

# Set x min and max
x_min <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> min()
x_max <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> max()

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = year, y = ma_3_incidents_per_100k, colour = city)) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = "", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    breaks = seq(x_min, x_max, 5),
    minor_breaks = seq(x_min, x_max, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05)),
    position = "bottom"
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    position = "right",
    limits = c(0, 3),
    breaks = seq(0, 2.5, 0.5),
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ",", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))   # lines should not sit on the axis
  ) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = line_colours
  ) +
  
  guides(x = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +
  
  theme(
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(
      size = rel(1),
      hjust = 1.0,
      vjust = -0.5,
      margin = margin(r = 12, l = -15)
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Homicide victims",
    subtitle = "Incidents per 100,000 residents, three-year moving average<br>",
    caption = "Source: Statistics Canada | *Charting Waterloo Region*"
  )


```

## Violent Crime

### Waterloo Region, Ontario, and Canada

```{r plot-violent-incidents-vs-Can-Ont}
# ggline
plot_data <- incident_summary |>
  filter(str_detect(region, "WRPS|Canada|Ontario"))

# Set x min and max
x_min <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> min()
x_max <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> max()

# Define scale colours
group_colours <- comp_colours

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = year, y = incidents_per_100k_violent, colour = region)) +

  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = "", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    minor_breaks = seq(x_min, x_max, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05)),
    position = "bottom"
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    position = "right",
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ",", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))   # lines should not sit on the axis
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = group_colours
  ) +

  guides(x = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +

  theme(
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(
      size = rel(1),
      hjust = 1.0,
      vjust = -0.5,
      margin = margin(r = 12, l = -20)
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = str_glue("Number of Violent Criminal Incidents: {first_year_incident_summary}-{latest_year_incident_summary}"),
    subtitle = "Per 100,000 population<br>",
    caption = "Source: Statistics Canada | *Charting Waterloo Region*"
  )
```

## Largest Increases Over the Past Decade

```{r decade-change-data}
incidents_decade_change <- incidents |>
  group_by(region, type, category, subcategory, class, violation_master) |>
  summarise(
    incidents_per_100k_start = sum(incidents_per_100k[year == decade_ago_incidents], na.rm = TRUE),
    incidents_per_100k_latest = sum(incidents_per_100k[year == latest_year_incidents], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    change_vs_start = incidents_per_100k_latest - incidents_per_100k_start,
    perc_change_vs_start = case_when(
      incidents_per_100k_start == 0 ~ str_glue("Zero in {decade_ago_incidents}"),  # Avoid division by zero
      TRUE ~ as.character(round(change_vs_start / incidents_per_100k_start * 100, 1))
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(region, type, desc(change_vs_start))
```

```{r violent-incidents-top10-increases-decade}
# gglollipop
plot_data <- incidents_decade_change |>
  filter(
    region == "WRPS",
    type == "Violent"
  ) |>
  slice_max(n = 10, order_by = change_vs_start) |>
  mutate(
    violation_master = reorder(violation_master, change_vs_start),
    y_label = as.character(violation_master)
  )

# Pre-compute labels to avoid data masking issue in scale_y_discrete
y_labels <- plot_data |> select(violation_master, y_label) |> deframe()

plot_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = change_vs_start, y = violation_master)) +

  geom_segment(aes(
    x = 0, xend = change_vs_start,
    y = violation_master,
    yend = violation_master),
    color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.7) +

  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = change_vs_start,
      y = violation_master
    ),
    shape = 19, size = 3,
    color = dodgerblue
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ",", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    position = "top"
  ) +

  scale_y_discrete(
    position = "left",
    labels = y_labels
  ) +

  # Horizontal chart: swap tufte's default grid orientation
  theme(
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y.left = element_markdown()
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Increases in Violent Crime",
    subtitle = str_glue("Increase in incidents per 100,000 residents, Waterloo Region, {latest_year_incidents} vs {decade_ago_incidents}"),
    caption = "Source: Statistics Canada | *Charting Waterloo Region*"
  )
```

## Selected Offences

```{r assaults-base-wrps, fig.height=10, fig.width=7}
plot_data <- incidents |>
  filter(
    region %in% c("Canada", "Ontario", "WRPS"),
    ucr_code %in% c("135", "1410", "1420", "1430", "1440", "1470", "1480")
  ) |>
  mutate(violation_master = replace_when(violation_master, class == "Other Assaults" ~ "Other Assaults")) |> 
  summarise(incidents_per_100k = sum(incidents_per_100k), .by = c(year, region, violation_master)) |> 
  group_by(region, violation_master) |> 
  mutate(base_incidents = incidents_per_100k / first(incidents_per_100k, order_by = year) * 100) |>
  ungroup()

# Set x min and max
x_min <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> min()
x_max <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> max()

# Define scale colours
group_colours <- comp_colours

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = year, y = base_incidents, colour = region)) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = "", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    minor_breaks = seq(x_min, x_max, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05)),
    position = "bottom"
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    position = "right",
    expand_limits(y = 0),
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ",", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))   # lines should not sit on the axis
  ) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = group_colours
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(
    ~ violation_master,
    ncol = 2,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  
  guides(x = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +
  
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(
      size = rel(1),
      hjust = 1.0,
      vjust = -0.5,
      margin = margin(r = 12, l = -20)
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Assaults",
    subtitle = str_glue("Incidents per 100,000 residents, {first_year_incidents} = 100<br>"),
    caption = "Source: Statistics Canada | *Charting Waterloo Region*"
  )
```

```{r plot-csi-violent-incidents-vs-Can-Ont-yoy}
  scale_y_continuous(
    position = "right",
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ",", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = group_colours
  ) +

  guides(x = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +

  theme(
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(
      size = rel(1),
      hjust = 1.0,
      vjust = -0.5,
      margin = margin(r = 12, l = -20)
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = str_glue("Violent Crime Severity Index: {first_year_csi}-{latest_year_csi}"),
    subtitle = "Year-over-year change, %<br>",
    caption = "Source: Statistics Canada | *Charting Waterloo Region*"
  )
```

## The Big 12 Police Services

### Criminal Incidents and Crime Severity

```{r plot-big12-ranked-incidents}
# gghorbar (direct bar labels option) + ggfacet
plot_data <- incident_summary |>
  filter(
    in_big_12,
    year == latest_year_incident_summary
  ) |>
  select(region, comparison_group, incidents_per_100k_all, incidents_per_100k_violent, incidents_per_100k_nonviolent) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(incidents_per_100k_all, incidents_per_100k_violent, incidents_per_100k_nonviolent),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    metric_label = case_when(
      metric == "incidents_per_100k_all" ~ "Total",
      metric == "incidents_per_100k_violent" ~ "Violent",
      metric == "incidents_per_100k_nonviolent" ~ "Non-Violent"
    ),
    metric_label = factor(metric_label, levels = c("Total", "Violent", "Non-Violent"))
  ) |>
  group_by(metric) |>
  mutate(region = reorder_within(region, value, metric)) |>
  ungroup()

plot_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = region, fill = comparison_group)) +

  geom_col(width = 0.7) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  # Direct bar labels, inside right of bar
  geom_text(
    aes(x = value, y = region,
        label = label_number(big.mark = ",", scale = 1, accuracy = 1)(value)),
    hjust = 1.15,
    vjust = 0.5,
    size = 3.2,
    colour = "white"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ metric_label,
    ncol = 3,
    scales = "free"
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +

  scale_y_reordered() +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = set_names(manual_2_colours, c("Other Big 12", "WRPS"))
  ) +

  # Horizontal chart: swap tufte's default grid orientation
  theme(
    axis.text.y.left = element_markdown(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    # sit the legend above the facet strips rather than on top of them
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "left"
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +

  labs(
    title = str_glue("Criminal Incidents: {latest_year_incident_summary}"),
    subtitle = "per 100,000 residents<br>",
    caption = "Source: Statistics Canada | *Charting Waterloo Region*"
  )
```

## Crime Severity and Clearance Rates in Waterloo Region

```{r plot-csi-clearance-wrps, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
# ggline + ggfacet
# Define groups based on y variable
orig_groups <- c("base_csi", "base_clearance_rate")
renamed_groups <- c("CSI", "Clearance Rate")

plot_data <- csi |>
  filter(region == "WRPS") |>
  select(year, base_csi:base_clearance_rate_nonviolent) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = base_csi:base_clearance_rate_nonviolent,
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "base_rate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      str_detect(metric, "_violent$") ~ "Violent Crimes",
      str_detect(metric, "_nonviolent$") ~ "Non-violent Crimes",
      TRUE ~ "All Crimes"
    ),
    statistic = case_when(
      str_detect(metric, "base_csi") ~ "CSI",
      str_detect(metric, "base_clearance_rate") ~ "Clearance Rate"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(statistic)) |>
  arrange(type, year)

# Set x min and max
x_min <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> min()
x_max <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> max()

# Define scale colours
group_colours <- set_names(manual_2_colours, rev(renamed_groups))

# Direct line labels, placed in the "All Crimes" panel only
label_data <- plot_data |>
  filter(year == 2006, type == "All Crimes") |>
  mutate(
    label = statistic,
    fontface = "bold",
    nudge_y = 5
  )

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = year, y = base_rate, colour = statistic)) +

  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +

  geom_label(
    data = label_data,
    aes(
      x = year,
      y = base_rate + nudge_y,
      label = label,
      fontface = fontface
    ),
    colour = "grey30",
    fill = "white",
    linewidth = 0,
    size = 3.2,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = 0,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ type,
    ncol = 1,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = "", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    minor_breaks = seq(x_min, x_max, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05)),
    position = "bottom"
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    position = "right",
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ",", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))   # lines should not sit on the axis
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = group_colours,
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  guides(x = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +

  theme(
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(
      size = rel(1),
      hjust = 1.0,
      vjust = -0.5,
      margin = margin(r = 12, l = -20)
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Trends in Crime Severity Index and CSI-Weighted Clearance Rate",
    subtitle = str_glue("Waterloo Region, {first_year_csi}-{latest_year_csi}, {first_year_csi} = 100<br>"),
    caption = "Source: Statistics Canada | *Charting Waterloo Region*"
  )
```

```{r plot-big12-exp-per-capita-rank}
# gghorbar
plot_data <- big_12_financials |>
  filter(
    year == latest_year_financials_reported,
    !is.na(total_exp_per_capita)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    region = reorder(region, total_exp_per_capita),
    y_label = if_else(region == "WRPS", "**WRPS**", as.character(region))
  )

# Pre-compute labels to avoid data masking issue in scale_y_discrete
y_labels <- plot_data |> select(region, y_label) |> deframe()

plot_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = total_exp_per_capita, y = region, fill = comparison_group)) +

  geom_col(width = 0.7) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_dollar(),
    position = "top"
  ) +

  scale_y_discrete(
    position = "left",
    labels = y_labels
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = set_names(manual_2_colours, c("Other Big 12", "WRPS")),
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  # Horizontal chart: swap tufte's default grid orientation
  theme(
    axis.text.y.left = element_markdown(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  ) +

  labs(
    title = str_glue("Total Police Expenditures per Capita: {latest_year_financials_reported}"),
    subtitle = str_glue("no {financials_not_reporting} data, {latest_year_financials} $"),
    caption = "Source: Ontario Financial Information Returns | *Charting Waterloo Region*"
  )
```

```{r plot-cop-civ-staffing-area}
# ggarea
renamed_groups <- c("Officers", "Civilians")

plot_data <- personnel |>
  filter(region == "WRPS") |>
  select(year, Officers = prop_officers, Civilians = prop_civilians) |>
  pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "dept", values_to = "staffing_prop")

# Set x min and max
x_min <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> min()
x_max <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> max()

# Define scale colours
group_colours <- set_names(rev(manual_2_colours), renamed_groups)

# Mean officer share sets the boundary between the two bands
mean_officers <- plot_data |>
  filter(dept == "Officers") |>
  pull(staffing_prop) |>
  mean(na.rm = TRUE)

# Create explicit label positions - inside each band
label_data <- tibble(
  x = median(c(x_min, x_max)),
  y = c(mean_officers / 2, mean_officers + (100 - mean_officers) / 2),
  label = renamed_groups,
  fontface = c("bold", "bold")
)

# Officer share at the first and latest year
end_labels <- plot_data |>
  filter(dept == "Officers", year %in% c(x_min, x_max))

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = year, y = staffing_prop, fill = dept)) +

  geom_area() +

  geom_text(
    data = label_data,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      label = label,
      fontface = fontface
    ),
    colour = "white",
    size = 3.2,
    hjust = 0.5,
    vjust = 0.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = end_labels,
    aes(
      x = if_else(year == x_min, year - 1, year + 1),
      y = staffing_prop,
      label = label_number(accuracy = 0.1, suffix = "%")(staffing_prop)
    ),
    colour = dodgerblue,
    size = 3.2,
    fontface = "bold",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = "", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    minor_breaks = seq(x_min, x_max, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.04)),
    position = "bottom"
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    position = "right",
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ",", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.0, 0.05))
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = group_colours,
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  guides(x = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +

  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "WRPS Officer and Civilian Staffing Levels",
    subtitle = str_glue("Proportion of total staffing, {first_year_personnel}-{latest_year_personnel}<br>"),
    caption = str_glue("Source: Statistics Canada | *Charting Waterloo Region* | no data for {personnel_missing_years}")
  )
```

```{r plot-base-cop-civ-staffing-wr}
# ggline (direct line labels, decade reference lines)
renamed_groups <- c("Officers", "Civilians", "CSI")

plot_data <- personnel |>
  filter(region == "WRPS") |>
  select(year, Officers = base_officers_per_100k, Civilians = base_civilians_per_100k, CSI = base_csi) |>
  pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "stat", values_to = "base_rate")

# Set x min and max
x_min <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> min()
x_max <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> max()

# Define scale colours
group_colours <- set_names(manual_3_colours, c("CSI", "Civilians", "Officers"))

# Decade-ago values and percentage changes for reference lines and labels
baseline_decade_ago <- plot_data |>
  filter(year == decade_ago_personnel) |>
  select(stat, baseline_value = base_rate)

final_year_data <- plot_data |>
  filter(year == max(year)) |>
  select(stat, final_value = base_rate, final_year = year)

pct_changes <- baseline_decade_ago |>
  left_join(final_year_data, by = "stat") |>
  mutate(
    pct_change = round(((final_value - baseline_value) / baseline_value) * 100, 1),
    pct_label = case_when(
      pct_change > 0 ~ paste0("+", pct_change, "%"),
      TRUE ~ paste0(pct_change, "%")
    )
  )

# Direct line labels
label_data <- plot_data |>
  filter(year == 2005) |>
  mutate(
    label = stat,
    fontface = "plain",
    nudge_y = if_else(stat == "Civilians", 4, -4)
  )

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = year, y = base_rate, colour = stat)) +

  # Reference lines from the decade-ago value
  geom_segment(
    data = pct_changes,
    aes(x = decade_ago_personnel, xend = x_max,
        y = baseline_value, yend = baseline_value,
        colour = stat),
    linetype = "dashed",
    alpha = 0.6,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +

  geom_point(
    data = plot_data |>
      filter(year %in% c(decade_ago_personnel, max(year))),
    aes(colour = stat),
    size = 2
  ) +

  # Values at the decade-ago and latest year
  geom_text(
    data = plot_data |>
      filter(year %in% c(decade_ago_personnel, max(year))),
    aes(label = label_number(accuracy = 1)(base_rate)),
    show.legend = FALSE,
    size = 3.2,
    vjust = -0.8
  ) +

  # Percentage change between the reference line and the trend line
  geom_text(
    data = pct_changes,
    aes(x = final_year - 1,
        y = (baseline_value + final_value) / 2,
        label = pct_label,
        colour = stat),
    show.legend = FALSE,
    size = 3.2,
    fontface = "bold",
    hjust = 0.5
  ) +

  geom_label(
    data = label_data,
    aes(
      x = year,
      y = base_rate + nudge_y,
      label = label,
      fontface = fontface
    ),
    colour = "grey30",
    fill = "white",
    linewidth = 0,
    size = 3.2,
    hjust = 0.5,
    vjust = 0.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = "", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    minor_breaks = seq(x_min, x_max, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05)),
    position = "bottom"
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    position = "right",
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ",", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = group_colours,
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  guides(x = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +

  theme(
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(
      size = rel(1),
      hjust = 1.0,
      vjust = -0.5,
      margin = margin(r = 12, l = -20)
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Trends in WRPS Staffing Levels vs Crime Severity Index",
    subtitle = str_glue("Staffing based on positions per 100,000 population,<br>percentage change {latest_year_personnel} vs {decade_ago_personnel} also reported, {first_year_personnel} = 100<br>"),
    caption = str_glue("Source: Statistics Canada. Table 35-10-0077-01 | *Charting Waterloo Region* | no data for {personnel_missing_years}")
  )
```

```{r plot-officer-civilian-ratio-wrps}
# Ribbon floor - the lowest gridline
ribbon_floor <- 1.5

plot_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = officer_civilian_ratio)) +

  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = ribbon_floor, ymax = officer_civilian_ratio),
    fill = cowboysilver,
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +

  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = dodgerblue) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = "", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    minor_breaks = seq(x_min, x_max, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05)),
    position = "bottom"
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    position = "right",
    breaks = seq(1.5, 3.0, 0.3),
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ",", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +

  guides(x = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +

  theme(
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(
      size = rel(1),
      hjust = 1.0,
      vjust = -0.5,
      margin = margin(r = 12, l = -20)
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Ratio of WRPS Officer to Civilian Staffing Levels",
    subtitle = "Number of officers per civilian staff person<br>",
    caption = str_glue("Source: Statistics Canada | *Charting Waterloo Region* | no data for {personnel_missing_years}")
  )
```

## Clearance Rates

```{r plot-clearance-rates-big12}
# ggline
plot_data <- big_12

# Set x min and max
x_min <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> min()
x_max <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> max()

# Define scale colours
group_colours <- comp_colours

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = year, y = weighted_clearance_rate, group = region)) +

  # Background layer - Other Big 12
  geom_line(
    data = plot_data |> filter(comparison_group == "Other Big 12"),
    aes(colour = comparison_group),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +

  # Foreground layer - everything else
  geom_line(
    data = plot_data |> filter(comparison_group != "Other Big 12"),
    aes(colour = comparison_group),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = "", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    minor_breaks = seq(x_min, x_max, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05)),
    position = "bottom"
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    position = "right",
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ",", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))   # lines should not sit on the axis
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = group_colours
  ) +

  guides(x = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +

  theme(
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(
      size = rel(1),
      hjust = 1.0,
      vjust = -0.5,
      margin = margin(r = 12, l = -20)
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "CSI-Weighted Clearance Rates, %",
    subtitle = "WRPS vs Canada, Ontario, and Other Big 12 Forces<br>",
    caption = str_glue("Source: Statistics Canada | *Charting Waterloo Region* | no data for {personnel_missing_years}")
  )
```

```{r plot-big12-clearance}
# gglollipoplabel
plot_data <- csi |>
  filter(
    in_big_12,
    year == latest_year_csi
  ) |>
  mutate(
    region = reorder(region, weighted_clearance_rate),
    y_label = if_else(region == "WRPS", "**WRPS**", as.character(region))
  )

# Pre-compute labels to avoid data masking issue in scale_y_discrete
y_labels <- plot_data |> select(region, y_label) |> deframe()

plot_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = weighted_clearance_rate, y = region)) +

  geom_segment(aes(
    x = 0, xend = weighted_clearance_rate,
    y = region,
    yend = region),
    color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.7) +

  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = weighted_clearance_rate,
      y = region
    ),
    shape = 19, size = 3,
    color = dodgerblue
  ) +

  # Direct point labels replacing x axis
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = weighted_clearance_rate,
      y = region,
      label = label_number(big.mark = ",", scale = 1, suffix = "%", accuracy = 0.1)(weighted_clearance_rate)
    ),
    nudge_x = 1.5,    # in data units; adjust after initial render
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0.5,
    size = 3.2,
    colour = "grey30"
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))
  ) +

  scale_y_discrete(
    position = "left",
    labels = y_labels
  ) +

  # Horizontal chart: no x axis or gridlines - direct labels replace them
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y.left = element_markdown()
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +

  labs(
    title = str_glue("Weighted Clearance Rate of Big 12, %: {latest_year_csi}"),
    subtitle = "<br>",
    caption = "Source: Statistics Canada | *Charting Waterloo Region*"
  )
```

```{r big-12-ranked-data}
big_12_ranked <- csi |>
  filter(in_big_12) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  mutate(
    clearance_rank = row_number(desc(weighted_clearance_rate)),
    csi_rank = row_number(csi),
    weighted_clearance_rate_violent = round(weighted_clearance_rate_violent, 1)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(
    year,
    region,
    csi,
    weighted_clearance_rate,
    weighted_clearance_rate_violent,
    csi_rank,
    clearance_rank,
    comparison_group
  ) |>
  arrange(year, clearance_rank)

# Ordinal labels for rank axes
ordinal_labels <- function(x) {
  paste0(x, case_when(
    x %% 100 %in% 11:13 ~ "th",
    x %% 10 == 1 ~ "st",
    x %% 10 == 2 ~ "nd",
    x %% 10 == 3 ~ "rd",
    TRUE ~ "th"
  ))
}
```

```{r clearance-rank-by-year-big-12}
# ggline (step variant)
plot_data <- big_12_ranked |>
  filter(region == "WRPS") |>
  arrange(year) |>
  mutate(
    prev_rank = lag(clearance_rank, default = NA),
    line_from_above = !is.na(prev_rank) & prev_rank < clearance_rank,
    vjust_position = if_else(line_from_above, 1.5, -0.8)
  )

# Set x min and max
x_min <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> min()
x_max <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> max()

n_forces <- max(big_12_ranked$clearance_rank, na.rm = TRUE)

plot_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = clearance_rank)) +

  geom_step(linewidth = 0.8, colour = dodgerblue) +

  geom_point(size = 2, colour = dodgerblue) +

  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = label_number(accuracy = 1)(weighted_clearance_rate),
      vjust = vjust_position
    ),
    size = 3.2,
    colour = "grey30"
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = "", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    minor_breaks = seq(x_min, x_max, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05)),
    position = "bottom"
  ) +

  scale_y_reverse(
    position = "right",
    breaks = 1:n_forces,
    labels = ordinal_labels(1:n_forces),
    limits = c(n_forces, 0.5)
  ) +

  guides(x = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +

  theme(
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(
      size = rel(1),
      hjust = 1.0,
      vjust = -0.5,
      margin = margin(r = 12, l = -20)
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "WRPS Clearance Rate Ranking Among Big 12 Police Services",
    subtitle = "Point labels report weighted clearance rates<br>",
    caption = "Source: Statistics Canada | *Charting Waterloo Region*"
  )
```

```{r test-heat-map}
# ggheatrank
# Create y-axis ordering vector
row_order <- big_12_ranked |>
  group_by(region) |>
  summarise(avg_rank = mean(clearance_rank, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_rank)) |>  # reverse order so best (lowest avg) appears at top
  pull(region)

# Define special formatting
highlight_row <- "WRPS"

# Prepare data with ordering and special formatting
plot_data <- big_12_ranked |>
  mutate(
    row_factor = factor(region, levels = row_order),
    row_label = if_else(region == highlight_row, paste0("**", highlight_row, "**"), as.character(region))
  )

# Set x min and max
x_min <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> min()
x_max <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> max()

# Pre-compute labels to avoid data masking issue in scale_y_discrete
y_labels <- plot_data |> select(row_factor, row_label) |> deframe()

# Define fill scale parameters
fill_colors <- alpha(dodgerblue, c(1.0, 0.7, 0.4, 0.1))
fill_breaks <- c(1, 3, 6, 9, 12)
fill_labels <- ordinal_labels(fill_breaks)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = year, y = row_factor, fill = clearance_rank)) +

  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +

  scale_fill_stepsn(
    colors = fill_colors,
    breaks = fill_breaks,
    labels = fill_labels,
    na.value = "black",
    guide = guide_coloursteps(
      reverse = TRUE,
      show.limits = FALSE,
      barwidth = unit(4, "cm"),
      barheight = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      frame.colour = "black",
      frame.linewidth = 0.3,
      label.vjust = -0.0
    )
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = "", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.0, 0.0)),
    position = "bottom"
  ) +

  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = y_labels
  ) +

  guides(x = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +

  # Heatmap: remove all gridlines (tiles define the structure)
  theme(
    axis.text.y.left = element_markdown(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Ranking of Big 12 Forces by Weighted Clearance Rate",
    subtitle = "Ordered best to worst by average ranking",
    caption = "Source: Statistics Canada | *Charting Waterloo Region*"
  )
```

```{r plot-off-per-100k-slope, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
# ggslope
plot_data <- big_12 |>
  filter(year %in% c(min(year, na.rm = TRUE), max(year, na.rm = TRUE)))

# Set x min and max
x_min <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> min()
x_max <- plot_data |> pull(year) |> max()

# Define line colours
group_colours <- comp_colours

# Label positions - taken from each group's value in the first year
label_data <- plot_data |>
  filter(year == x_min) |>
  summarise(
    y = mean(officers_per_100k, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = comparison_group
  ) |>
  mutate(
    x = if_else(comparison_group == "Other Big 12", mean(c(x_min, x_max)), x_min - 0.5),
    label = comparison_group,
    fontface = if_else(comparison_group == "WRPS", "bold", "plain"),
    hjust = if_else(comparison_group == "Other Big 12", 0.5, 1)
  )

  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +

  geom_point(size = 3.1, colour = "white") +  # white point to obscure line ends

  geom_point(size = 3.0) +

  geom_label(
    data = label_data,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      label = label,
      fontface = fontface,
      hjust = hjust
    ),
    colour = "grey30",
    fill = "white",
    linewidth = 0,
    size = 3.2,
    vjust = 0.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(x_min, x_max),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.20, 0.08))
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    position = "right",
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ",", scale = 1, suffix = ""),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))   # lines should not sit on the axis
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = group_colours,
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  theme(
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(
      size = rel(1),
      hjust = 1.0,
      vjust = -0.5,
      margin = margin(r = 12, l = -20)
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 13, l = 13, b = 13, r = 100)   # make plot area thinner

    title = str_glue("Officer Staffing {first_year_personnel} vs {latest_year_personnel}"),
```

```{r plot-off-civ-per-100k-change-since-base-year, fig.height=7, fig.width=8}
# ggdumbbell
plot_data <- big_12 |>
  filter(year == latest_year_personnel) |>
  mutate(
    perc_change_officers_per_100k = base_officers_per_100k - 100,
    perc_change_civilians_per_100k = base_civilians_per_100k - 100
  ) |>
  select(
    region,
    perc_change_officers_per_100k,
    perc_change_civilians_per_100k,
    in_big_12
  )

# Order: Canada and Ontario first, then Big 12 by officer change descending
big_12_order <- plot_data |>
  filter(in_big_12) |>
  arrange(desc(perc_change_officers_per_100k))

ordered_regions <- c("Canada", "Ontario", as.character(big_12_order$region))

plot_data <- plot_data |>
  mutate(
    region = factor(region, levels = rev(ordered_regions)),
    y_label = if_else(region == "WRPS", "**WRPS**", as.character(region))
  )

# Pre-compute labels to avoid data masking issue in scale_y_discrete
y_labels <- plot_data |> select(region, y_label) |> deframe()

# Reference segment spans the full data range
ref_min <- min(plot_data$perc_change_civilians_per_100k, plot_data$perc_change_officers_per_100k, na.rm = TRUE)
ref_max <- max(plot_data$perc_change_civilians_per_100k, plot_data$perc_change_officers_per_100k, na.rm = TRUE)

plot_data |>
  ggplot() +

  # Background reference segment spanning full x range
  geom_segment(aes(
    x = ref_min,
    xend = ref_max,
    y = region,
    yend = region
    ),
    color = "grey80",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +

  # Dumbbell segment connecting the two values
  geom_segment(aes(
    x = perc_change_officers_per_100k,
    xend = perc_change_civilians_per_100k,
    y = region,
    yend = region
    ),
    color = "grey50",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  geom_point(aes(
    x = perc_change_civilians_per_100k,
    y = region,
    color = "Civilians per 100k"
    ),
    shape = 19, size = 3
  ) +

  geom_point(aes(
    x = perc_change_officers_per_100k,
    y = region,
    color = "Officers per 100k"
    ),
    shape = 19, size = 3
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Civilians per 100k" = cowboysilver,
      "Officers per 100k" = dodgerblue
    ),
    name = NULL,
    breaks = c("Officers per 100k", "Civilians per 100k")
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(big.mark = ",", scale = 1, suffix = "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05)),
    position = "top"
  ) +

  scale_y_discrete(
    position = "left",
    labels = y_labels
  ) +

  # Horizontal chart: swap tufte's default grid orientation
  theme(
    axis.text.y.left = element_markdown(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.justification = c(1, 0),                 # anchor: right edge, bottom edge
    legend.position.inside = c(0.98, 0.03),         # empty space in the lower right
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Change in Officer and Civilian Staffing Levels",
    subtitle = str_glue("Big 12, Canada, and Ontario, {latest_year_personnel} vs {first_year_personnel}, % change"),
    caption = "Source: Statistics Canada. Tables 35-10-0076-01, 35-10-0077-01 | *Charting Waterloo Region*"
  )
```

```{r plot-Big12-ranked-staffing}
# gghorbar (direct bar labels option) + ggfacet
plot_data <- big_12 |>
  filter(
    year == latest_year_personnel,
    in_big_12
  ) |>
  select(region, comparison_group, officers_per_100k, civilians_per_100k, officer_civilian_ratio) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(officers_per_100k, civilians_per_100k, officer_civilian_ratio),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    metric_label = case_when(
      metric == "officers_per_100k" ~ "Officers per 100k",
      metric == "civilians_per_100k" ~ "Civilians per 100k",
      metric == "officer_civilian_ratio" ~ "Officer-Civilian Ratio"
    ),
    metric_label = factor(metric_label, levels = c("Officers per 100k", "Civilians per 100k", "Officer-Civilian Ratio"))
  ) |>
  group_by(metric) |>
  mutate(region = reorder_within(region, value, metric)) |>
  ungroup()

plot_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = region, fill = comparison_group)) +

  geom_col(width = 0.7) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  geom_text(
    aes(x = value, y = region,
        label = label_number(big.mark = ",", scale = 1, accuracy = 0.1)(value)),
    hjust = 1.15,
    vjust = 0.5,
    size = 3.2,
    colour = "white"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ metric_label,
    ncol = 3,
    scales = "free"
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +

  scale_y_reordered() +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = set_names(manual_2_colours, c("Other Big 12", "WRPS"))
  ) +

  theme(
    axis.text.y.left = element_markdown(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    # sit the legend above the facet strips rather than on top of them
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "left"
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +

  labs(
    title = str_glue("Staffing Levels of Big 12 Police Services: {latest_year_personnel}"),
    subtitle = "<br>",
    caption = "Source: Statistics Canada | *Charting Waterloo Region*"
  )
```
